description.narrative: Outputs for this activity included: Stakeholder inputs into CRAKS and workshop report

The key stakeholders included representatives of central and local government, producers, media, academia, private sector and civil society organisations. The project is conscious of gender and social inclusion and deliberately seeks women, youth and persons with disability represented within the categories above to enable shared of lived experiences
The objective of the inception meeting therefore is to introduce the project to key stakeholders, and gather feedback to inform project improvements and implementation.
